messages.author: 84abc5f39a8c5ed2
messages.subject: 3D fish data inquiry
parts:
Hi Dr. Chris and anyone else with insight,

First thank you for your efforts & extensive resources, all very helpful and very much appreciated. Please pardon if I haven't gotten to everything yet and am missing something obvious. 

I have been trying to analyze 3D acoustic telemetry data of fish from an artificial reef with CTMM and have had success in executing the main functions and producing 2D models/plots, but am struggling with incorporating depth which is a crucial component. I have found some threads on VMM from 2021, but first am curious if you have any other updated recommendations for depth?

I also am curious if this package is most appropriate for my data, given the following: the fish are constrained by the sea floor (~25 m), positions are calculated at a minimum interval rate of 10 secs (so ~140,000 events in a month, up to 7-9 months of data across 19 individuals), the fish are highly residential, and when filtered by DOP < 1, the data is inherently constrained to a ~200m x ~150m space. So home range is already bounded but my main research questions lie in how they are using specific parts of the habitat and how this use changes temporally. 

Thanks in advance,
-Clark

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: 3D fish data inquiry
parts:
Hi Clark,

I haven't updated the vertical code much since then, and if you run into any issues with it, then please let me know (it works a little differently and doesn't get as much attention from me during testing).

One thing that has improved is the ability to include bathymetry as an RSF parameter, and have the home-range estimates respect that selection (along with shoreline boundaries).

Best,
Chris
